title: Source Citation Gap After Hint Acceptance
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:hint record_collection=* citation_added=* accepted=*
| stats sum(eval(if(accepted="yes" AND citation_added="no",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by record_collection
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending accepted hints without citations backlog by record collection for research proofing.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside research proofing.
implementation: Mark each `genealogy:hint` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `record_collection`.
visualization: Table of record collection with pending accepted hints without citations counts.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors where unfinished accepted hints without citations are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in research proofing.
